title: Grade 4 Math — Tue, May 26
description: Perimeter & Area — Day 2 of 5: What is Area?
subject: mathematics

questions.question: What is area?
options: The space covered by a shape (inside)
The length of the longest side
questions.explanation: Area = the amount of surface inside a shape. We measure how much space it covers.

questions.question: Which unit is used to measure area?
questions.explanation: Area is measured in SQUARE units: cm², m², km². We are counting squares that fit inside.

questions.question: Area of a square with side 6 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of square = side × side = 6 × 6 = 36 cm².

questions.question: Area of a rectangle 8 cm long and 5 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Area of rectangle = length × width = 8 × 5 = 40 cm².

questions.question: A square tile has side 3 cm. How many tiles cover a surface of 90 cm²?
A room is 7 m long and 4 m wide. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = 7 × 4 = 28 m². Room area tells you how much floor you have.

questions.question: Rectangle has area 48 cm² and length 8 cm. What is its width?
A square has area 64 cm². What is the length of one side?
Shape A: rectangle 10×2 cm. Shape B: square 5×5 cm. Which has the bigger area?
questions.explanation: A = 10×2 = 20 cm². B = 5×5 = 25 cm². Shape B has bigger area.

questions.question: A wall 4 m × 3 m needs painting. Each litre of paint covers 6 m². How many litres needed?
A rectangle has perimeter 30 cm and width 5 cm. What is its area?
Grid has 4 rows and 6 columns of 1 cm squares. Total area?
questions.explanation: Count squares: 4 rows × 6 columns = 24 squares = 24 cm².

questions.question: If the length of a rectangle doubles but width stays the same, what happens to area?
questions.explanation: A = l×w. If l→2l: A = 2l×w = 2×(l×w). Area doubles.
